source.anchors: OOXML paragraph numbers, not page numbers

classifications.DONE+TESTED: Implemented supported profile with local/mock tests; live status separate.
classifications.DONE+LIVEPENDING: Implemented supported profile and mock tests; new profile real acceptance still pending.
classifications.REQUIREDGAP: Original requirement incomplete or mandatory live/client gate not closed.
classifications.UNSUPPORTEDbyAPI: Only independently demonstrated provider restriction, not a local implementation limitation.
classifications.OPTIONALbeyondoriginal: No explicit original paragraph mandate, even when later user authorized and implemented.

evidence_boundaries.pending_root_work: Tracking empty protobuf-default comparison normalization is uncommitted root-only work at audit; no claim of product test execution by this documentation audit.
evidence_boundaries.quality: Use final root quality/CI artifact after integration. This doc audit verifies references/JSON/format/secrets only; historic security baseline preserved.

requirements.requirement: Provider-derived preview, validate_only, browser approval, exact immutable commit, fresh stale/TTL/consumption guards
Account allowlist, workspace/token ownership, scopes and MCC context; gates default OFF
500-operation bound, per-row Russian/local/provider errors and preserved source/code; Stage1 partial failure
remaining_limits: Stage0 and interdependent creation graphs use atomic partial_failure=false, as required by P103.

requirements.requirement: Stable commit identities, journal, exact before/after, irreversible warning and fresh inverse preview where reversible
remaining_limits: No automatic deletion inverse for creations/removals.
Inherited/zero CPC override and newly created local modifier cannot advertise invented positive-value or delete-based inverse. Explicit captured-value updates support inverse.
Campaign PAUSE cannot advertise ENABLE inverse bypassing launch checklist.

requirements.requirement: Exact absolute/percentage money, Google currency_constant billable units, half-up quantization and >50% warnings
remaining_limits: No FX or Intl/hardcoded precision fallback. Missing/mismatched authoritative unit and positive money rounding to zero reject.

requirements.requirement: Campaign/ad-group/ad creation PAUSED; activation separate and checklist guarded
requirements.live_status: Stage01 Search previous PASS; new PMax pending
remaining_limits: Asset/link criteria may be ENABLED beneath PAUSED campaign/group; preview states this, no activation of delivery parents.

requirements.requirement: Streamable HTTP typed tools, descriptions/annotations, bounded profiles, structuredContent plus text independent of client UI
remaining_limits: Schemas/stock HTTP tests are not real ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Cursor acceptance.

requirements.requirement: OAuth2.1 MCP write identity for each employee, authenticated approval/audit ownership without URL key
remaining_limits: At audited 6fb30ac, private controlled-write principal is scoped service identity; native OAuth mapping to equivalent Google write approval identity is in progress in independent branch. Existing public read OAuth does not satisfy write scope.

requirements.requirement: Same protected operations through authenticated REST fallback and OpenAPI3.1
remaining_limits: GET /mcp/openapi and POST /mcp/rest/:tool use authenticated private contract; deployment routing supplies external /api/v1 prefix.

requirements.requirement: Actual Q ChatGPT / R second client and S explicit user consent before commits
remaining_limits: Q/R clients not connected; cross-client S pending. Harness human approval PASS is not live Q/R/S.

requirements.requirement: Currency budget and Search campaign names/bidding/dates/network defaults
remaining_limits: Non-shared budget name provider-derived from campaign, never custom daily suffix. Authoritative-money extension awaits new live validation.

requirements.requirement: Geo name resolution, languages, PRESENCE default and positive radius/proximity
remaining_limits: Typed coordinates/radius, no invented geocoding; new proximity profile mock-tested, not in historical T live.

requirements.requirement: Optional quarter-hour schedule validation and account timezone
Action existence/status/ownership/data validation and exact campaign goals/config
remaining_limits: No fabricated conversion health; same-account supported goals only. TEST preflight has 0 conversion actions.

requirements.requirement: PAUSED groups/keywords, reused Stage1 duplicate/negative conflicts and explicit currency bids
PAUSED RSA plus text/call/business assets and existing owned image/logo references
remaining_limits: Search Stage0 brief uses image/logo references, not inline upload; bounded binary creation exists in Stage4 before assembly.
Historical T covered RSA and four sitelinks, not every asset form.

requirements.requirement: UTM/tracking and atomic temporary-ID creation graph
Clone existing Search campaign with new name/geo/budget and immutable source
remaining_limits: Implemented bounded Search MANUAL_CPC/MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS clone.

Whole preview rejects shared-list links, proximity/audience/device criteria, non-keyword/non-RSA resources, multi-final URLs, custom/cross-account goals, call/business/unknown assets and unsupported networks/bidding/geo modes.
These are local coverage gaps, not Google API impossibility. No silently dropped component.

requirements.requirement: Actual launch checklist, safe URL probes, conversion/policy warnings and separate campaign resume
remaining_limits: PAUSED groups/ads and pending policy warnings remain visible; conversion optimization failures block activation.

requirements.requirement: Keyword status/create/match replacement/final URL and protected removal
remaining_limits: Historical A/B/C/F/M/O exercised live status/replacement/protection; not every new money/URL case.

requirements.requirement: Campaign/group negatives, shared lists and search-term conversion using common builders/conflicts
Keyword CPC / group CPC+tCPA / budget absolute-percent changes and shared impact
remaining_limits: Inherited zero keyword bid needs explicit absolute input, not invented default.
G/H/N are mock/disposable equivalents, live pending.

requirements.requirement: Manual CPC, Max Clicks/Conversions, tCPA/tROAS/tImpressionShare and bounded parameters/clears
remaining_limits: Search-compatible strategy/profile checks; optional supported clear_fields implemented, required targets never silently cleared.
Arbitrary parameters/hotel profiles outside local supported profile.

requirements.requirement: Portfolio create/update and campaign attach/detach with all impacted campaigns proved
remaining_limits: Same-account/currency and existing compatible budget profile; no invented cross-account or budget realignment.
Manager cross-account portfolio management is not explicitly required by P182–184.

requirements.requirement: Campaign device modifiers and AdGroupBidModifier inherited/local override
remaining_limits: Device0 or0.1..10; automatic strategy compatibility explicit. Creating local override has no automatic removal inverse.

requirements.requirement: Exact existing geo/schedule modifier leaves without collection replacement
Frozen performance selections, exact money comparisons, bounded mixed rows and impact/audit
remaining_limits: Performance metric drift may stale preview; no automatic retry/refresh of approved selection.

requirements.requirement: Campaign/group audiences, exclude/remove, visible observation/targeting, modifier and name catalogs
remaining_limits: Mode/strategy/channel compatibility enforced; unsupported combinations explicitly rejected, not advertised as globally available.
Only independently proven OBSERVATION audience modifiers.

requirements.requirement: Custom audience terms/URLs/apps definitions create/update with exact composition
remaining_limits: Separate CustomAudienceService transport; no invented mixed GoogleAdsService operation.
Contextual segments, no Customer Match/PII list uploads.

requirements.requirement: Age/gender/parental/income include/exclude and supported existing criterion modifiers
remaining_limits: Country/channel eligibility checked by provider validation. Criteria/catalog read is implemented; a standalone demographic performance reporting tool is not claimed.

requirements.requirement: City/region include/exclude, radius, official name suggestions and presence modes
remaining_limits: Ambiguous name rejects with candidates; typed proximity include only; no guessed coordinates.
Excluded radius is rejected by bounded contract rather than silently converted.

requirements.requirement: Language aliases, account-timezone schedules, device exclusions and exact incremental criteria updates
Create/edit RSA text/pins/paths/URLs 30/90/15, moderation warning, status and protected remove
remaining_limits: K/L mock/disposable equivalents; historical T RSA does not establish live new AdService edit profile.

requirements.requirement: Text/call/business/image/logo asset creation and supported account/campaign/group links
remaining_limits: Safe inline JPEG/PNG only, ≤1MiB each/≤2MiB decoded total/≤8; full pixel decode+canonical reencode; no arbitrary URL/path.
Eligible existing refs require owner/type/dimensions proof; no binary in response/audit/browser review.

requirements.requirement: Tracking template/suffix account/campaign/group set/typed clear, exact masks, inverse values
remaining_limits: Typed clears of supported fields now implemented; no arbitrary raw masks.
Invalid historic tracking value cannot receive fabricated rollback; source comparison preserves raw provider reread.

requirements.requirement: Compare tracking changes against existing READ link/UTM audit
remaining_limits: audit_links_and_utms and get_tracking_specs are COMPAT_UNAVAILABLE_READ_TOOLS in V2 at audited baseline.
Stage4 own URL/UTM checks are implemented but are not P244 READ-audit integration.

requirements.requirement: Campaign status/name/dates/networks; group create/name/status and Search builder reuse
remaining_limits: Campaign ENABLE routes through Stage0 checklist; PAUSE inverse cannot bypass it.

requirements.requirement: Existing PMax complete asset-group creation and content edits, signals/themes, supported negatives/brand exclusion
remaining_limits: Existing PAUSED parent independently proved; complete required assets and brand mode, not partial empty group.
Minimum-assets-safe detach/atomic replace preserves owned asset objects; typed irreversible association removal acknowledgment.
Brand exclusion uses existing owned ENABLED BRANDS list; no guessed enum or new brand registry entry.
Fresh TEST account has no IMAGE assets/conversion actions; PMax live pending.

requirements.requirement: Later explicit user-authorized non-retail full atomic PMax creation beyond original P254–257 editing requirement
remaining_limits: Implemented/mock-tested; PAUSED graph, exact same-account actual conversion actions, explicit brand guidelines and EU declaration, authoritative currency units.
Retail/feed/travel/local-services special profiles not implemented and not presumed original mandatory.
